title: The Day of Forty Open Tabs
skyStory: The moon is a waxing gibbous now, seventy-six percent bright and still lingering in Gemini, curious about absolutely everything. It has opened forty tabs on the cosmic browser. Comets, recipes, the history of mittens. Mars says, close some. The moon says, but they are all interesting. Saturn quietly bookmarks the important ones for later and closes the rest.

reading: Your curiosity is at full power, and that is both your gift and your trap today. You will start reading about one thing and end up, two hours later, knowing far too much about the migratory habits of eider ducks.

That is fine, in moderation. But the [[Knight of Wands]] is clearing his throat. Choose one rabbit hole for the day and explore it properly. Then teach someone what you learned at dinner, in your best storytelling voice. A Life Path 3 should never waste a good fact. Bonus points if the fact involves ducks.
joel.mission: Learn one weird fact today and teach it to someone before bedtime with full enthusiasm.
joel.omen: A duck, real or on a sign. It means your curiosity is about to lead somewhere useful.
joel.stoneWhy: calm water for a busy brain

reading: Your mind is a lighthouse sweeping across a wide grey sea today, catching glimpses of a dozen interesting ships. Do not chase them all. Pick one, the most curious looking one, and follow it to harbour.

Around 4:15 pm someone will mention a book, a show or an idea in passing. Write it down. The Wood Rat knows that the best treasures arrive disguised as small talk. This one is going to matter later, maybe in April. Your Life Path 11 is already humming about it, quietly, like a kettle just before it sings.
nancy.mission: Write down one thing someone mentions in passing today and look into it before the week is out.
nancy.omen: A boat or a ship in a picture or on a mug. It means a good idea is sailing toward you.
nancy.stoneWhy: a clear beam for the lighthouse
nancy.elementWhy: ideas carried in on sea breezes

together.text: Send each other the single strangest fact you learned this week. No explanation, no context, just the fact. The other has to reply with a question. Gemini loves a curious pair, and the universe is a library that never closes.
